leadText: (Japanese: ポケモンだじゃれクラブ　ゴージャス！ Pokémon Pun Club: Gorgeous!) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by 春風邪三太 Santa Harukaze. It was serialized in the Pokémon Fan magazine as (Japanese: ポケモン超だじゃれクラブ Pokémon Super Pun Club). It is 192 pages long.
